errorNetwork.en: Arkvory did not answer. Check your network connection and try again.
errorNetwork.text: Arkvory 没有响应。请检查网络连接后重试。

errorTimeout.en: The server took too long to answer, so the request was stopped. Try again.
errorTimeout.text: 服务器响应时间过长，请求已停止。请重试。

errorGateway.en: A proxy in front of Arkvory did not get an answer from it. Try again shortly or contact the administrator.
errorGateway.text: Arkvory 前置的代理服务器没有收到 Arkvory 的响应。请稍后重试或联系管理员。

errorInternal.en: Unexpected server error. Report the request ID below to the administrator.
errorInternal.text: 服务器发生意外错误。请将下方的请求 ID 告知管理员。

errorUnavailable.en: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errorUnavailable.text: 服务暂时不可用。请稍后重试。

errorFeedbackDisabled.en: Feedback is turned off on this server. Write to info@proanima.net instead.
errorFeedbackDisabled.text: 此服务器已关闭反馈功能。请改为发送邮件至 info@proanima.net。

errorHubUnreachable.en: The server cannot reach ProAnimaStudio right now. Try again later or write to info@proanima.net.
errorHubUnreachable.text: 服务器目前无法连接 ProAnimaStudio。请稍后重试，或发送邮件至 info@proanima.net。

errorFeedbackLimited.en: Too many messages from this server. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errorFeedbackLimited.text: 来自此服务器的消息过多。请等待几分钟后重试。

errorReadOnly.en: This address only serves downloads. Make changes through the main Arkvory address.
errorReadOnly.text: 此地址仅提供下载。请通过 Arkvory 的主地址进行更改。

errorRouteMissing.en: This Arkvory server does not support the operation. Update the server or reload the console.
errorRouteMissing.text: 此 Arkvory 服务器不支持该操作。请更新服务器或重新加载控制台。

errorBodyTooLarge.en: The entered data is too large. Shorten the values and try again.
errorBodyTooLarge.text: 输入的数据过大。请缩短内容后重试。

errorMediaType.en: The server did not accept the request format. Reload the console.
errorMediaType.text: 服务器不接受此请求格式。请重新加载控制台。

errorMalformed.en: The server could not read the request. Reload the console and try again.
errorMalformed.text: 服务器无法读取该请求。请重新加载控制台后重试。

errorFields.text: 请检查突出显示的字段。

errorRange.en: The requested part of the file is not available. Restart the download.
errorRange.text: 请求的文件部分不可用。请重新开始下载。

errorTooManyRequests.en: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errorRegistrationLimited.en: Too many sign-up attempts from this network. Wait and try again.
errorRegistrationLimited.text: 来自此网络的注册尝试过多。请稍后重试。

errorPasswordLimited.en: Too many wrong attempts at the current password. Wait and try again.
errorPasswordLimited.text: 当前密码尝试错误次数过多。请稍后重试。

sessionEnded.en: Your session has ended: you signed out elsewhere, changed the password or access was revoked. Sign in again.
sessionEnded.text: 您的会话已结束：您已在其他地方退出登录、修改了密码，或访问权限已被撤销。请重新登录。

errorTokenExpired.en: This key or token has expired. Create a new one and connect again.
errorTokenExpired.text: 此密钥或令牌已过期。请创建新的密钥或令牌，然后重新连接。

errorReadOnlyToken.en: This token can only read. Use a read-write token or sign in with your password.
errorReadOnlyToken.text: 此令牌只能读取。请使用读写令牌，或使用密码登录。

errorCredentialRevoked.en: The key used for this action was revoked or has expired.
errorCredentialRevoked.text: 用于此操作的密钥已被撤销或已过期。

errorSessionRequired.en: This action needs a password sign-in; keys and tokens cannot do it.
errorSessionRequired.text: 此操作需要使用密码登录；密钥和令牌无法执行此操作。

errorAdministratorRequired.en: Only an administrator can do this.
errorAdministratorRequired.text: 只有管理员可以执行此操作。

errorRegistrationDisabled.en: Self sign-up is turned off. Ask an administrator for an account.
errorRegistrationDisabled.text: 自助注册已关闭。请联系管理员为您创建账户。

errorOriginForbidden.en: The server does not allow requests from this console address. Contact the administrator.
errorOriginForbidden.text: 服务器不允许来自此控制台地址的请求。请联系管理员。

errorUploadExpired.en: The upload expired before it was finished. Start a new upload.
errorUploadExpired.text: 上传在完成前已过期。请开始新的上传。

errorUploadState.en: This upload is already published or cancelled. Start a new upload.
errorUploadState.text: 此上传已发布或已取消。请开始新的上传。

errorRevisionMismatch.en: Someone changed this item meanwhile. Reload it and apply your change again.
errorRevisionMismatch.text: 此项目在此期间已被他人修改。请重新加载，然后再次应用您的更改。

errorVersionExists.en: This package version already exists. Publish it under a new version.
errorVersionExists.text: 此包版本已存在。请使用新版本发布。

errorPartsIncomplete.en: Some parts of the file have not arrived yet. Resume the upload.
errorPartsIncomplete.text: 文件的部分分片尚未送达。请续传。

errorIdempotency.en: This duplicate protection key was already used for another file. Start a new upload to get a new key.
errorIdempotency.text: 此防重复键已用于另一个文件。请开始新的上传以获取新键。

errorAlreadyExists.en: An item with this name already exists. Choose another name.
errorAlreadyExists.text: 已存在同名项目。请选择其他名称。

errorStageLimit.en: This artifact already has the maximum number of stages. Remove one first.
errorStageLimit.text: 此制品的阶段数量已达上限。请先移除一个阶段。

errorStorageQuota.en: The repository quota is used up. Delete old builds or ask an administrator to raise it.
errorStorageQuota.text: 仓库配额已用尽。请删除旧构建，或请管理员提高配额。

errorStorageFull.en: The server disk is full. Contact the administrator.
errorStorageFull.text: 服务器磁盘已满。请联系管理员。

errorAccountLimit.en: The maximum number of accounts has been reached.

errorGroupLimit.en: The maximum number of groups has been reached.

errorMembershipLimit.en: The maximum number of group members has been reached.

errorGrantLimit.en: The maximum number of access rules has been reached.
errorGrantLimit.text: 访问规则数量已达上限。

errorKeyLimit.en: The key limit for this account has been reached. Revoke unused keys first.
errorKeyLimit.text: 此账户的密钥数量已达上限。请先撤销不再使用的密钥。

errorTokenLimit.en: You already have the maximum of active tokens. Revoke unused tokens first.
errorTokenLimit.text: 您的有效令牌数量已达上限。请先撤销不再使用的令牌。

errorDelegationLimit.en: The maximum number of delegations has been reached.

errorCatalogLimit.en: The storage catalog is full. Contact the administrator.
errorCatalogLimit.text: 存储目录已满。请联系管理员。

errorQueueFull.en: The processing queue is full. Try again later.
errorQueueFull.text: 处理队列已满。请稍后重试。

errorTransferLimit.en: Too many transfers are running right now. Try again later.
errorTransferLimit.text: 当前正在进行的传输过多。请稍后重试。

errorCompletionFailed.en: The server could not finish this upload. Start a new upload or contact the administrator.
errorCompletionFailed.text: 服务器无法完成此上传。请开始新的上传或联系管理员。

errorUnexpectedResponse.en: The server sent an answer this console does not understand. Update the server or the console.
errorUnexpectedResponse.text: 服务器返回了此控制台无法识别的响应。请更新服务器或控制台。

fieldLength.en: The length is outside the allowed range.

fieldRange.en: The value is outside the allowed range.

fieldType.en: This kind of value is not accepted.

fieldUnknown.en: The server does not accept this field.

managementEmpty.en: No entries available for this credential.
managementEmpty.text: 当前凭据没有可用的条目。

repositoryModel.en: A repository appears once access to it is granted. Renaming or deleting repositories is not available here.
repositoryModel.text: 获得仓库的访问权限后，仓库才会显示在这里。此处不支持重命名或删除仓库。

servicePolicyHint.en: A key can do only what both this policy and the key itself allow. An empty policy gives no access to files.
servicePolicyHint.text: 密钥只能执行此策略和密钥本身都允许的操作。空策略不授予任何文件访问权限。

serviceDisableHint.en: Disabling blocks every key of this account. Active transfers may finish.
serviceDisableHint.text: 停用后，此账户的所有密钥都将被阻止。正在进行的传输可以完成。

serviceDelegated.en: Access is limited to assigned accounts and actions.
serviceDelegated.text: 访问权限仅限于分配给您的账户和操作。

bindingInvalid.en: Use unique repository IDs and select at least one permission for each repository.
bindingInvalid.text: 请使用不重复的仓库 ID，并为每个仓库至少选择一项权限。

keyNew.text: 新建密钥 / 取消轮换

keyExpiry.text: 过期时间（本地时间，可选）

keyExpiryHint.en: Default: up to 90 days. Maximum: 365 days, also limited by the issuing operator’s expiry.
keyExpiryHint.text: 默认最长 90 天，上限为 365 天，且不得晚于签发者自身密钥的过期时间。

keyRotationHint.en: Rotation cannot expand permissions. Activating the replacement limits the old key to at most 24 more hours. Delegations are not copied.
keyRotationHint.text: 轮换不能扩大权限。激活替换密钥后，旧密钥最多还能使用 24 小时。委派不会被复制。

keyRevokeHint.en: Revocation is permanent. Existing transfers may finish; new requests will be rejected.
keyRevokeHint.text: 撤销是永久性的。正在进行的传输可以完成；新的请求将被拒绝。

keySecretHint.en: Shown once. Save the secret securely before closing.
keySecretHint.text: 仅显示一次。关闭前请妥善保存此机密。

keySecretMissing.en: The key was already issued; its secret cannot be shown again. Find it in the list, revoke it and issue another key if needed.
keySecretMissing.text: 此密钥已签发，其机密无法再次显示。如有需要，请在列表中找到该密钥，将其撤销后签发新密钥。

keyCopyFailed.en: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the secret manually.
keyCopyFailed.text: 剪贴板不可用。请手动选择并复制机密。

keyActivated.en: Key activated. Store it securely before closing.
keyActivated.text: 密钥已激活。关闭前请妥善保存。

keyActivateHint.en: Activate after saving the secret. Pending credentials expire after 15 minutes.
keyActivateHint.text: 保存机密后再激活。待激活的凭据将在 15 分钟后过期。

keyRetryHint.en: After a network failure, retry without changing the form to reuse the issuance request. A lost secret cannot be recovered.
keyRetryHint.text: 发生网络故障后，请在不修改表单的情况下重试，以复用同一个签发请求。丢失的机密无法找回。

managementConfirmName.en: Type the displayed name to confirm
managementConfirmName.text: 输入显示的名称以确认

delegationHint.en: Only the server owner (the setup account) can change delegations. Removing a delegation does not revoke keys its holder already activated.
delegationHint.text: 只有服务器所有者（初始设置时创建的账户）可以更改委派。移除委派不会撤销被委派者已激活的密钥。

welcomePartial.en: The owner account exists. Sign in and finish repository permissions in Access groups; account creation must not be repeated.
welcomePartial.text: 所有者账户已存在。请登录，并在“访问组”中完成仓库权限设置；请勿重复创建账户。

welcomeAccessBody.en: On Windows, use the owner account you created in Setup. For a headless installation, create an owner using the private recovery key on the server.
welcomeAccessBody.text: 在 Windows 上，请使用安装程序中创建的所有者账户。对于无图形界面的安装，请在服务器上使用私有恢复密钥创建所有者。

welcomeName.en: Owner name · 3–64 Latin letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore
welcomeName.text: 所有者名称 · 3–64 个拉丁字母、数字、点、短横线或下划线

welcomePassword.text: 密码 · 至少 12 个字符

welcomeCreated.en: Owner created. Sign in with your new password. Keep the recovery key offline.
welcomeCreated.text: 所有者已创建。请使用新密码登录。请离线保管恢复密钥。

welcomePublishBody.en: Start with a small file in releases. Add labels and metadata; UPack builds can also carry manifests and attachments.
welcomePublishBody.text: 先在 releases 中上传一个小文件。添加标签和元数据；UPack 构建还可以附带清单和附件。

welcomeConnectBody.en: Give each integration its own service account and only the repository actions it needs. The API catalog shows the operations available to you.
welcomeConnectBody.text: 为每个集成分配单独的服务账户，并只授予它所需的仓库操作权限。API 目录会显示您可用的操作。

welcomeOperateBody.en: Before remote access: configure HTTPS, backups and disk alerts. Updates are opt-in. Local storage is a single-server profile.
welcomeOperateBody.text: 开放远程访问前，请配置 HTTPS、备份和磁盘告警。更新需要手动启用。本地存储属于单服务器配置。

helpLoad.text: 加载允许的 API 操作

helpHint.en: Sign in to see API operations available to your account.
helpHint.text: 登录后即可查看您的账户可用的 API 操作。

helpRemoteCliBody.en: Install the separate Arkvory CLI package on your computer. It includes Node.js and needs no server services. Store your key in a private file. Repeat the same transfer command after interruption; use --json for CI/CD.
helpRemoteCliBody.text: 在您的计算机上安装独立的 Arkvory CLI 包。它自带 Node.js，不需要任何服务器服务。请将密钥保存在私有文件中。传输中断后，重新执行同一条传输命令即可；在 CI/CD 中请使用 --json。

helpCliBody.en: Run from an elevated terminal on the server. These commands manage deployment; integrations use the HTTP API and SDK. Replace ROOT with the installation directory.
helpCliBody.text: 请在服务器上以管理员身份打开的终端中运行。这些命令用于管理部署；集成请使用 HTTP API 和 SDK。请将 ROOT 替换为安装目录。

helpDocsBody.en: Installation, everyday work, clients and protocols, operation, backups and the full HTTP API reference, in the language of the console.
helpDocsBody.text: 以控制台当前的语言提供：安装、日常使用、客户端与协议、运维、备份以及完整的 HTTP API 参考。

helpRecipesBody.en: Read capabilities → discover repositories → create upload with an idempotency key → resume parts → complete → poll readiness → download using Range and ETag. Never blindly retry a non-idempotent write.
helpRecipesBody.text: 读取 capabilities → 发现仓库 → 使用幂等键创建上传 → 续传分片 → 完成上传 → 轮询就绪状态 → 使用 Range 和 ETag 下载。切勿盲目重试非幂等的写入操作。

cleanupHelp.en: Frees disk space without stopping Arkvory. Active transfers and pinned files are deferred. Enable only after every Arkvory server is updated, including read servers and background processors. Pausing finishes the current file. The grace period is not a recycle bin.
cleanupHelp.text: 在不停止 Arkvory 的情况下释放磁盘空间。正在传输的文件和已固定的文件会推迟处理。请在所有 Arkvory 服务器（包括读取服务器和后台处理进程）都完成更新后再启用。暂停时会先处理完当前文件。宽限期不是回收站。

cleanupRequested.en: Batch requested. Refresh status to see its result.
cleanupRequested.text: 已请求执行一批。刷新状态即可查看结果。

cleanupStats.en: Last batch: freed {bytes} · processed {collected} · deferred {deferred} · failed {failed}
cleanupStats.text: 上一批：释放 {bytes} · 已处理 {collected} · 已推迟 {deferred} · 失败 {failed}

updateAutomatic.text: 自动安装兼容的稳定版

updateStatistics.text: 向 ProAnimaStudio 发送匿名统计信息

updateHub.en: Channel: {channel}. Versions are approved in the ProAnimaStudio hub; GitHub is used only when the hub cannot be reached. Statistics: a random installation id, version, system and installed updates — no names, addresses or content. Without statistics a version arrives only when it is rolled out to everyone.
updateHub.text: 通道：{channel}。版本由 ProAnimaStudio 中心审核批准；仅当无法连接中心时才使用 GitHub。统计信息包括随机的安装 ID、版本、系统和已安装的更新，不含名称、地址或内容。不发送统计信息时，只有在某个版本向所有人推出后才会收到它。

updatePolicyHelp.en: Checks run every 6 hours, even when automatic installation is off. Automatic installation runs once per day during the selected UTC hour. A release that changes the database schema installs only after the server has captured and verified a fresh backup.
updatePolicyHelp.text: 每 6 小时检查一次，即使关闭了自动安装也会检查。自动安装每天在所选的 UTC 时段内运行一次。对于会更改数据库架构的版本，只有在服务器创建并验证了新的备份之后才会安装。

updateUnavailable.en: The host updater is not connected. Ask the server administrator to connect it using updates-connect.
updateUnavailable.text: 主机更新程序未连接。请服务器管理员使用 updates-connect 进行连接。

updateStale.en: The host updater has stopped reporting. Check the scheduler and installation lock on the server.
updateStale.text: 主机更新程序已停止上报。请检查服务器上的计划任务和安装锁。

updateWorking.en: Installing the release. The service may briefly disconnect; this page will reconnect.
updateWorking.text: 正在安装版本。服务可能会短暂断开；此页面将自动重新连接。

updatePending.en: Request accepted. Waiting for the host updater (usually within one minute).
updatePending.text: 请求已接受。正在等待主机更新程序处理（通常在一分钟内）。

updatePinned.en: Version is pinned. Remove the pin on the server before installing from the console.
updatePinned.text: 版本已固定。请先在服务器上取消固定，再从控制台安装。

updateMaintenance.en: Installation refused: a release that changes the database schema needs a fresh verified backup. Connect a backup vault and complete the first backup, then check again, or upgrade manually on the server.
updateMaintenance.text: 安装被拒绝：会更改数据库架构的版本需要一个经过验证的新备份。请连接备份存储并完成首次备份，然后再次检查；或在服务器上手动升级。

updateMigration.en: This release changes the database schema. The server captures and verifies a backup before installing, so installation takes longer.
updateMigration.text: 此版本会更改数据库架构。服务器会在安装前创建并验证备份，因此安装耗时更长。

updateCheckFailed.en: Release check failed. The displayed release may be outdated. Check GitHub access and credentials on the server.
updateCheckFailed.text: 检查版本失败。显示的版本可能已过时。请检查服务器对 GitHub 的访问和凭据。

updateFailed.en: Update failed. Inspect the installation journal and service logs before retrying.
updateFailed.text: 更新失败。重试前请检查安装日志和服务日志。

updateRecovery.en: Manual recovery is required. Inspect processes, installation lock and journal on the server.
updateRecovery.text: 需要手动恢复。请检查服务器上的进程、安装锁和日志。

updateConflict.en: Settings changed while the request was waiting. Refresh and submit again.
updateConflict.text: 请求等待期间设置已更改。请刷新后重新提交。

updateConfirmHelp.en: Active transfers may be interrupted and need to resume. The installer verifies the release, backs up first when the database schema changes, and attempts rollback if startup fails. Schedule this action during a maintenance window.
updateConfirmHelp.text: 正在进行的传输可能会中断，需要续传。安装程序会验证版本，在数据库架构变更时先进行备份，并在启动失败时尝试回滚。请在维护时段内执行此操作。

updateConnection.en: Cannot contact Arkvory. Retrying automatically; do not submit another installation request.
updateConnection.text: 无法连接 Arkvory。正在自动重试；请勿再次提交安装请求。

backupNewestHelp.en: Age counts from the snapshot time T: a backup contains the data as of T, not as of its completion. Hover the age for the exact local time.
backupNewestHelp.text: 距今时间从快照时间 T 起算：备份包含截至 T 时刻的数据，而不是截至完成时的数据。将鼠标悬停在距今时间上可查看确切的本地时间。

backupVaultUnknown.en: Unknown while the agent is offline

backupWarningVaultNotConfigured.en: Backup storage is not configured for the agent
backupWarningVaultNotConfigured.text: 未为代理配置备份存储

backupWarningBackupStale.en: The latest backup is out of date

backupWarningVaultLowSpace.en: Backup storage is running out of space
backupWarningVaultLowSpace.text: 备份存储空间即将用尽

backupWarningVerifyFailed.text: 某个恢复点未通过验证

backupWarningNeverDeepVerified.en: No full verification for more than 8 days
backupWarningNeverDeepVerified.text: 超过 8 天未进行完整验证

backupActionVaultNotConfigured.en: Set ARKVORY_BACKUP_VAULT to a directory prepared with vault init in the environment of the arkvory-backup service and restart it. Once installers support it, use arkvory configure --backup-vault.
backupActionVaultNotConfigured.text: 在 arkvory-backup 服务的环境中，将 ARKVORY_BACKUP_VAULT 设置为已用 vault init 准备好的目录，然后重启该服务。待安装程序支持后，可改用 arkvory configure --backup-vault。

backupActionAgentOffline.en: Start the arkvory-backup service (npm run backup -- agent) and check its journal. Without the agent nothing is copied.
backupActionAgentOffline.text: 启动 arkvory-backup 服务（npm run backup -- agent）并检查其日志。没有代理，就不会备份任何数据。

backupActionScheduleDisabled.en: Turn on the plan below if backups must run every day.
backupActionScheduleDisabled.text: 如果需要每天备份，请启用下方的计划。

backupActionNoBackupYet.en: Create the first backup with "Create backup now".
backupActionNoBackupYet.text: 点击“立即备份”创建第一个备份。

backupActionBackupStale.en: The newest point is older than 26 hours. Check the job error codes below and the agent journal.
backupActionBackupStale.text: 最新的恢复点已超过 26 小时。请检查下方任务的错误代码和代理日志。

backupActionLastRunFailed.en: The error code is in the job table; the agent journal has the record backup.request.failed.
backupActionLastRunFailed.text: 错误代码见任务表；代理日志中有 backup.request.failed 记录。

backupActionVaultUnavailable.en: The backup storage volume is not mounted, has no vault.json or is not writable. Check the disk or NAS on the server.
backupActionVaultUnavailable.text: 备份存储卷未挂载、缺少 vault.json 或不可写。请检查服务器上的磁盘或 NAS。

backupActionVaultLowSpace.en: Less than 10% or less than twice the last new data is free. Free space on the backup volume or keep fewer points.
backupActionVaultLowSpace.text: 可用空间不足 10%，或不足上次新增数据量的两倍。请释放备份卷上的空间，或减少保留的恢复点。

backupActionVerifyFailed.en: Do not change the backup storage. Find the point with a verification error below and investigate its code.
backupActionVerifyFailed.text: 请勿更改备份存储。在下方找到验证出错的恢复点，并根据其错误代码排查原因。

backupActionNeverDeepVerified.en: Run "Verify fully" for the newest point and check that the agent is running.
backupActionNeverDeepVerified.text: 对最新的恢复点运行“完整验证”，并确认代理正在运行。

backupRestoreNote.en: Restoring is an operator action on the server, into an empty target.
backupRestoreNote.text: 恢复由运维人员在服务器上执行，且目标必须为空。

backupRestoreHelp.en: On the server: npm run backup -- restore --vault <vault> --point <id> --storage <empty directory>, with ARKVORY_RESTORE_DATABASE_URL of an empty database. Run it first without --yes (a check that writes nothing), then with --yes, start a separate instance on the restored data and check it before switching production. Details: the documentation, "Backups".
backupRestoreHelp.text: 在服务器上运行：npm run backup -- restore --vault <vault> --point <id> --storage <空目录>，并将 ARKVORY_RESTORE_DATABASE_URL 设为一个空数据库。先不带 --yes 运行（仅检查，不写入任何内容），再带 --yes 运行；然后在恢复的数据上启动一个独立实例，检查无误后再切换生产环境。详情请参阅文档中的“备份”。

backupRunQueued.en: Backup queued. The agent starts it at its next queue check.
backupRunQueued.text: 备份已加入队列。代理会在下次检查队列时开始执行。

backupRetentionQueued.en: Retention queued: the agent removes the points outside the policy.
backupRetentionQueued.text: 保留任务已加入队列：代理将删除不符合策略的恢复点。

backupPinDone.text: 恢复点已固定：保留规则不会删除它。

backupPointsHelp.en: Retention keeps the newest point of each of the last N local days of the plan time zone, and likewise of weeks and months, plus pinned points and the newest point. Other points of the same day are removed: pin a point you must keep.
backupPointsHelp.text: 保留规则会按计划所用时区，为最近 N 个本地日各保留最新的一个恢复点，周和月同理；此外还会保留已固定的恢复点和最新的恢复点。同一天的其他恢复点将被删除：必须保留的恢复点请固定。

backupPointsEmpty.en: No restore points in the current backup storage yet.
backupPointsEmpty.text: 当前备份存储中还没有恢复点。

backupRetentionConfirm.en: Apply retention now? Removal from the backup storage cannot be undone: the points below and the content no remaining point needs are deleted.
backupRetentionConfirm.text: 立即应用保留规则？从备份存储中删除的内容无法撤消：下方列出的恢复点，以及其余恢复点不再需要的内容，都将被删除。

backupJobsHelp.en: Jobs run in the backup agent on the server, one at a time; closing this page does not stop them. Every backup is followed by a structure check and retention.
backupJobsHelp.text: 任务由服务器上的备份代理逐个执行；关闭此页面不会停止任务。每次备份之后都会进行结构检查并应用保留规则。

backupPlanHelp.en: One backup per day at the chosen local time of an explicit time zone; a nonexistent time during a clock change runs at the change. After downtime one missed run is caught up. Turning the plan on does not start a backup immediately.
backupPlanHelp.text: 每天在指定时区的所选本地时间备份一次；如果该时间因时钟调整而不存在，则在调整时刻运行。停机后会补跑一次错过的备份。启用计划不会立即开始备份。

backupZoneUnknown.en: This browser does not know the zone; the server checks it on save.
backupZoneUnknown.text: 此浏览器无法识别该时区；服务器会在保存时进行检查。

backupRetentionLegend.en: Keep the newest point of the last
backupRetentionLegend.text: 保留最近若干天、周、月中每个周期的最新恢复点

backupPlanConflict.en: The plan was changed elsewhere. Its current version is loaded: review it and save again.
backupPlanConflict.text: 计划已在其他地方被修改。已加载其当前版本：请检查后再次保存。

backupReadOnly.en: Changing backups requires the backup management permission.
backupReadOnly.text: 更改备份需要备份管理权限。

copyFailed.en: The browser did not allow copying. Select the value and copy it manually.
copyFailed.text: 浏览器不允许复制。请选中该值并手动复制。

promotionHint.en: Stages mark where a build is approved. Promotion publishes the build in another repository without uploading it again.
promotionHint.text: 阶段标明构建已在何处获得批准。晋级会将构建发布到另一个仓库，无需重新上传。

stageRemoveConfirm.en: Remove stage {stage}? Deployments that resolve this stage will pick another version.
stageRemoveConfirm.text: 移除阶段 {stage}？按此阶段解析版本的部署将选取其他版本。

stageInvalid.en: Use lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 32 characters).
stageInvalid.text: 请使用小写字母、数字、点、短横线或下划线（最多 32 个字符）。

promoteNoTargets.en: No other repository allows you to promote.
promoteNoTargets.text: 没有其他允许您晋级的仓库。

promoteMove.en: Move: remove the build from this repository after promotion
promoteMove.text: 移动：晋级后从此仓库移除该构建

promoteMoveHint.en: Without Move, the build stays here and a copy appears in the target.
promoteMoveHint.text: 不选择“移动”时，构建会保留在此处，并在目标仓库中出现一份副本。

promoteMoveConfirm.en: Move the build to {repository}? It will be removed from this repository.
promoteMoveConfirm.text: 将构建移动到 {repository}？它将从此仓库中移除。

promoteExisting.text: 已在 {repository} 中发布；阶段已更新。

promoteMoved.en: Moved to {repository}. The build was removed from this repository.
promoteMoved.text: 已移动到 {repository}。该构建已从此仓库中移除。

mirrorDetails.en: Read-only copy of “{source}” from {upstream}, kept in sync by the server.
mirrorDetails.text: {upstream} 上“{source}”的只读副本，由服务器保持同步。

mirrorError.en: The last attempt failed ({code}); downloads keep working.
mirrorError.text: 上次尝试失败（{code}）；下载仍可正常进行。

mirrorImportDetails.en: Versions marked {stages} in “{source}” on {upstream} are copied here automatically. Later changes and deletions there do not affect them.
mirrorImportDetails.text: {upstream} 上“{source}”中标记为 {stages} 的版本会自动复制到这里。之后源仓库中的更改和删除不会影响这些版本。

reportIntro.en: Your message goes to the developers of Arkvory through the ProAnimaStudio hub. Only what this form shows is sent.
reportIntro.text: 您的消息将通过 ProAnimaStudio 中心发送给 Arkvory 的开发人员。只会发送此表单中显示的内容。

reportMessage.en: What happened, or what should work better?
reportMessage.text: 发生了什么问题，或者哪些地方可以改进？

reportScreenshots.en: Screenshots: paste from the clipboard (Ctrl+V), drop files here or choose them. Up to 6 PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images, 8 MB each.
reportScreenshots.text: 屏幕截图：从剪贴板粘贴（Ctrl+V）、将文件拖放到此处或选择文件。最多 6 张 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片，每张不超过 8 MB。

reportClientLog.text: 此页面的日志（共 {count} 条）

reportServerLog.text: 服务器日志和系统摘要

reportTail.en: The last {count} lines are shown; the whole log is attached.
reportTail.text: 仅显示最后 {count} 行；将附带完整日志。

reportSent.en: Thank you! Your message was sent, reference {id}.
reportSent.text: 谢谢！您的消息已发送，编号为 {id}。

reportMessageRequired.en: Describe the problem or the idea.

reportFileType.en: {name}: only PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images.
reportFileType.text: {name}：仅支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片。

reportTooLarge.en: Everything together is over 15 MB: remove some images.
reportTooLarge.text: 总大小超过 15 MB：请移除部分图片。

repositoryHint.en: After sign-in, the first repository available to you is selected.
repositoryHint.text: 登录后，将自动选择您可访问的第一个仓库。

keySignIn.en: Connect with a service or automation key
keySignIn.text: 使用服务密钥或自动化密钥连接

sessionExpired.en: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
sessionExpired.text: 您的会话已过期。请重新登录以继续。

errorSignInRequired.en: Sign in or connect with a service key to continue.
errorSignInRequired.text: 请登录或使用服务密钥连接以继续。

idempotencyHint.en: Prevents a retried upload from creating a second copy. It is sent as the Idempotency-Key of the request that creates the upload.
idempotencyHint.text: 防止重试的上传产生第二份副本。该键会作为创建上传的请求的 Idempotency-Key 发送。

storageUsageUnlimited.en: Published {published} · unfinished uploads {pending} · awaiting cleanup {retired} · in use {total} · no quota
storageUsageUnlimited.text: 已发布 {published} · 未完成的上传 {pending} · 等待清理 {retired} · 已用 {total} · 无配额

storageQuotaInvalid.en: Enter the quota in GiB, for example 50 or 0.5.
storageQuotaInvalid.text: 请以 GiB 为单位输入配额，例如 50 或 0.5。

helpHintConnected.en: You are connected. Load the API operations your access allows.
helpHintConnected.text: 已连接。加载您的访问权限所允许的 API 操作。

helpRemoteCliExample.en:
arkvoryctl --help
arkvoryctl profile add production --server https://arkvory.example --token-file /private/arkvory.key
arkvoryctl doctor
arkvoryctl packages publish build.upack --label test
arkvoryctl download ARTIFACT_ID ./build.upack
helpRemoteCliExample.text:
arkvoryctl --help
arkvoryctl profile add production --server https://arkvory.example --token-file /private/arkvory.key
arkvoryctl doctor
arkvoryctl packages publish build.upack --label test
arkvoryctl download ARTIFACT_ID ./build.upack

helpCliExample.en:
arkvory help
arkvory status --root ROOT
arkvory update --root ROOT
arkvory configure --root ROOT --disable-updates
arkvory configure --root ROOT --pin --version 1.2.3
helpCliExample.text:
arkvory help
arkvory status --root ROOT
arkvory update --root ROOT
arkvory configure --root ROOT --disable-updates
arkvory configure --root ROOT --pin --version 1.2.3

serviceEmptyOwner.en: The owner key from the server file is meant for setup, not automation: create a service account below, then issue a key for it.
serviceEmptyOwner.text: 服务器文件中的所有者密钥用于初始设置，而不是自动化：请在下方创建服务账户，然后为其签发密钥。

serviceEmptyDelegated.en: No service accounts are assigned to you yet. Ask the server owner to delegate one.
serviceEmptyDelegated.text: 目前还没有分配给您的服务账户。请联系服务器所有者为您委派一个。

repositoryEmpty.en: No repositories are available to this account or key.
repositoryEmpty.text: 此账户或密钥没有可用的仓库。

routeUnknown.en: This link does not match a console section. The artifact list is shown instead.
routeUnknown.text: 此链接与控制台中的任何部分都不匹配。已改为显示制品列表。

routeUnavailable.en: This section is not available to the current account or key. The artifact list is shown instead.
routeUnavailable.text: 当前账户或密钥无法使用此部分。已改为显示制品列表。

routeArtifactMissing.en: The linked artifact was not found or is not available to you.
routeArtifactMissing.text: 未找到链接指向的制品，或您无权访问该制品。

routeSignIn.en: Sign in to open the linked page.
routeSignIn.text: 请登录以打开链接指向的页面。

confirmDisableUser.en: Disable {name}? Active sessions end immediately and personal tokens stop working until the account is enabled again.
confirmDisableUser.text: 停用 {name}？其活动会话将立即结束，个人令牌在账户重新启用之前都将失效。

confirmRemoveMember.en: Remove {user} from {group}? They lose the repository access granted through this group.
confirmRemoveMember.text: 将 {user} 从 {group} 中移除？该用户将失去通过此组获得的仓库访问权限。

confirmRemoveGrant.en: Remove access of {group} to {repository}? Group members lose this access immediately.
confirmRemoveGrant.text: 移除 {group} 对 {repository} 的访问权限？组成员将立即失去此访问权限。

storageHelp.en: Retention applies to registered UPack builds. Pinned builds, file history and protected labels survive. Save a disabled policy first to preview it; enabling starts automatic deletion. Disk space is reclaimed below without stopping Arkvory.
storageHelp.text: 保留规则适用于已注册的 UPack 构建。已固定的构建、文件历史记录和受保护的标签不受影响。请先保存一个未启用的策略进行预览；启用后将开始自动删除。下方的物理清理可在不停止 Arkvory 的情况下回收磁盘空间。

storageGrouping.text: 最近 N 个的计数范围

storageKeep.text: 保留最近 N 个构建（默认）

storageAge.text: 删除前的最短保留时间（小时）

storageQuota.text: 配额，GiB（留空表示不限制仓库）

storageProtected.text: 受保护的标签（以逗号分隔）

storageChannels.en: Channel overrides: label=N, one per line
storageChannels.text: 按通道覆盖：标签=N，每行一个

storageAcknowledge.en: I understand that saving an enabled policy authorizes automatic deletion.
storageAcknowledge.text: 我了解，保存已启用的策略即表示授权自动删除。

storageRevision.en: Policy version {revision} · last cleanup deleted {count} builds
storageRevision.text: 策略版本 {revision} · 上次清理删除了 {count} 个构建

storageRunFailed.en: Automatic cleanup stopped: {code}. Check its authorizing key and storage health.
storageRunFailed.text: 自动清理已停止：{code}。请检查授权此清理的密钥以及存储的健康状况。

storageUsage.en: Published {published} · unfinished uploads {pending} · awaiting cleanup {retired} · in use {total} of {quota}
storageUsage.text: 已发布 {published} · 未完成的上传 {pending} · 等待清理 {retired} · 已用 {total} / {quota}

storageNormal.en: Capacity is below warning thresholds, or no repository quota is set.
storageNormal.text: 容量低于警告阈值，或未设置仓库配额。

storageWarning.en: Storage is approaching its quota. Review retention and schedule physical cleanup.
storageWarning.text: 存储用量接近配额。请检查保留策略并安排物理清理。

storageCritical.en: Storage is near or at its quota. New reservations that exceed the quota are rejected.
storageCritical.text: 存储用量已接近或达到配额。超出配额的新预留将被拒绝。

storageConfirmRequired.en: Automatic cleanup requires deletion permission and explicit acknowledgement.
storageConfirmRequired.text: 自动清理需要删除权限和明确确认。

storageSaved.en: Policy saved. An enabled policy will run automatically.
storageSaved.text: 策略已保存。已启用的策略将自动运行。

storagePreviewCount.en: Saved policy: {count} deletion candidates in this batch.
storagePreviewCount.text: 已保存的策略：本批次有 {count} 个删除候选项。

storagePreviewMore.en: Saved policy: {count} candidates shown; more remain.
storagePreviewMore.text: 已保存的策略：已显示 {count} 个候选项，还有更多。

deletionHelp.en: Deletion removes this artifact from the catalog and prevents new downloads. It cannot be undone here. Existing file history, attachments and external references are protected. Disk space is reclaimed separately during maintenance.
deletionHelp.text: 删除会将此制品从目录中移除，并阻止新的下载。此操作无法在此处撤消。现有的文件历史记录、附件和外部引用受到保护。磁盘空间会在维护期间单独回收。

deletionBlocked.en: Deletion is blocked by retained references.
deletionBlocked.text: 存在保留的引用，无法删除。

deletionReady.en: No blocking references. This explicit action permits deletion whatever the labels, release included. Dependencies and metadata will be checked again.
deletionReady.text: 没有阻止删除的引用。这一明确操作允许删除制品，无论它带有什么标签，包括 release。依赖项和元数据将再次检查。

deletionReference.en: An external service has pinned this artifact.
deletionReference.text: 外部服务已固定此制品。

deletionAsset.en: A file path or its history uses this artifact.
deletionAsset.text: 某个文件路径或其历史记录正在使用此制品。

deletionAttachment.en: Another build lists this artifact as an attachment, now or in its history.
deletionAttachment.text: 另一个构建当前或在其历史记录中将此制品列为附件。

deletionLabel.en: A retention rule protects this label.
deletionLabel.text: 某条保留规则保护此标签。

deletionStage.en: The artifact is promoted to a stage; remove the stage first.
deletionStage.text: 此制品已晋级到某个阶段；请先移除该阶段。

deletionConfirm.en: Paste the selected artifact ID to confirm deletion
deletionConfirm.text: 粘贴所选制品的 ID 以确认删除

deletionRecheck.en: The artifact changed or is protected. Check dependencies again before proceeding.
deletionRecheck.text: 制品已更改或受到保护。继续之前请重新检查依赖项。

deletionDone.en: Artifact deleted. Physical cleanup will run separately.
deletionDone.text: 制品已删除。物理清理将单独进行。

deletionRefresh.en: Artifact deleted, but the catalog could not be refreshed. Reload the list.
deletionRefresh.text: 制品已删除，但无法刷新目录。请重新加载列表。

labelsHelp.en: Use any labels. Presets can be combined; they do not move files or grant access.
labelsHelp.text: 可以使用任意标签。预设可以组合使用；标签不会移动文件，也不会授予访问权限。

metadataFilterHint.en: Key and value match exactly, including case. An empty value matches an empty field.
metadataFilterHint.text: 键和值必须完全匹配，区分大小写。空值匹配空字段。

metadataHelp.en: Up to 32 text fields. Examples: build.number, git.commit, target.os. Use a manifest for structured data.
metadataHelp.text: 最多 32 个文本字段。示例：build.number、git.commit、target.os。结构化数据请使用清单。

metadataInvalid.en: Check metadata: unique keys, text values and a valid JSON object are required.
metadataInvalid.text: 请检查元数据：键必须唯一，值必须为文本，并且必须是有效的 JSON 对象。

attachmentsHelp.en: Files belong to this build. Removing a link keeps the original file and its history.
attachmentsHelp.text: 这些文件属于此构建。移除链接会保留原始文件及其历史记录。

attachmentReloaded.en: Attachments reloaded. Your form is preserved.
attachmentReloaded.text: 附件已重新加载。表单中填写的内容已保留。

attachmentRecoveryHelp.en: Pause keeps this upload in the tab. Submit again to resume. If linking fails, the published file remains available by this ID; reload attachments before retrying. After closing the tab, use the Upload screen to resume by ID.
attachmentRecoveryHelp.text: 暂停会将此上传保留在当前标签页中。再次提交即可续传。如果链接失败，已发布的文件仍可通过此 ID 访问；重试前请重新加载附件。关闭标签页后，请在“上传”页面中按 ID 续传。

attachmentDuplicate.en: An attachment with this name already exists. Choose a different name or remove its link first.
attachmentDuplicate.text: 已存在同名附件。请选择其他名称，或先移除该附件的链接。

downloadHeld.en: Queue paused. New downloads will wait.
downloadHeld.text: 队列已暂停。新的下载将等待。

tableRegion.en: Results table — scroll horizontally for more columns
tableRegion.text: 结果表格（可水平滚动查看更多列）

searchEmpty.en: This repository has no artifacts yet.

downloadCleanupFailed.en: Saved. Temporary cleanup failed; use Remove finished to retry.
downloadCleanupFailed.text: 已保存。临时文件清理失败；请使用“移除已完成”重试。

downloadRestored.en: Restored · choose a destination to resume
downloadRestored.text: 已恢复 · 选择保存位置以继续

downloadRestoreReady.en: Queue restored. Resume each file to choose its destination.
downloadRestoreReady.text: 队列已恢复。请逐个继续下载，并为每个文件选择保存位置。

downloadRestoreEmpty.en: No saved downloads for this connection.
downloadRestoreEmpty.text: 此连接没有已保存的下载。

downloadSaving.text: 正在保存已验证的文件…

downloadPolicySaved.en: Queue limits updated. Downloads already running will continue.
downloadPolicySaved.text: 队列限制已更新。正在进行的下载将继续。

downloadSummary.text: 活动：{active} · 等待：{waiting} · 总计：{count}

downloadDuplicate.en: This destination is already in the queue. Remove its finished job first.
downloadDuplicate.text: 此保存位置已在队列中。请先移除对应的已完成任务。

downloadEmpty.en: Choose Download next to a file in the catalog.
downloadEmpty.text: 在目录中点击文件旁边的“下载”。

downloadWaitTimeout.en: Queue wait expired. You can retry.
downloadWaitTimeout.text: 队列等待已超时。您可以重试。

downloadQueueFull.en: Queue is full. Remove finished jobs to make room.
downloadQueueFull.text: 队列已满。请移除已完成的任务以腾出空间。

downloadDiskFull.en: Browser storage is full. Cancel unused downloads to free staging space.
downloadDiskFull.text: 浏览器存储已满。请取消不需要的下载以释放暂存空间。

downloadNote.en: After a page reload, reconnect and restore the queue. Resume each file to choose its destination. Sealed segments remain in browser storage; credentials are not saved. The destination is replaced only after checksum verification. Browser storage needs space for the file.
downloadNote.text: 页面重新加载后，请重新连接并恢复队列。逐个继续下载，为每个文件选择保存位置。已封存的分段会保留在浏览器存储中；凭据不会被保存。只有在校验和验证通过后，才会替换目标文件。浏览器存储需要有足够的空间容纳该文件。

keyPlaceholder.en: Paste a service or automation key
keyPlaceholder.text: 粘贴服务密钥或自动化密钥

keyHint.en: The key stays in this tab. It is never saved in browser storage.
keyHint.text: 密钥仅保留在此标签页中，绝不会保存到浏览器存储。

adminHint.en: Create accounts and grant repository access through groups.
adminHint.text: 创建账户，并通过组授予仓库访问权限。

packageFilterHint.en: Group and name are exact matches, ignoring letter case.
packageFilterHint.text: 组和名称须完全匹配，不区分大小写。

applyFilters.en: Apply the filters to see packages.
applyFilters.text: 应用筛选条件以查看包。

apiAddressError.en: The Arkvory API address is invalid. Contact the UI administrator.
apiAddressError.text: Arkvory API 地址无效。请联系界面管理员。

noRepositoryAccess.en: This account or key cannot read any repositories. Ask an administrator for access.
noRepositoryAccess.text: 此账户或密钥无法读取任何仓库。请联系管理员获取访问权限。

noPackages.en: No registered packages match these filters.
noPackages.text: 没有符合这些筛选条件的已注册包。

passwordChangedSignIn.text: 密码已修改。请重新登录。

passwordChanged.text: 密码已修改；活动会话已撤销

tokenCreatedWarning.en: Save this token now. It will not be shown again.
tokenCreatedWarning.text: 请立即保存此令牌。它不会再次显示。

noUserTokens.en: No personal access tokens generated yet.
noUserTokens.text: 尚未生成个人访问令牌。

tokenSessionOnly.en: Tokens are created and revoked from a password session only; a token cannot create tokens or administer accounts.
tokenSessionOnly.text: 令牌只能在密码登录的会话中创建和撤销；令牌不能创建令牌，也不能管理账户。

tokenRevokeConfirm.en: Revoke “{name}”? Clients using it lose access immediately.
tokenRevokeConfirm.text: 撤销“{name}”？使用此令牌的客户端将立即失去访问权限。

tokenCopyFailed.en: Copy failed. The token is selected; copy it manually.
tokenCopyFailed.text: 复制失败。令牌已选中，请手动复制。

emptyDescription.en: Sign in with your username and password, or connect with a service key.
emptyDescription.text: 请使用用户名和密码登录，或使用服务密钥连接。

noResults.en: Change your search or clear the filters.
noResults.text: 请修改搜索条件或清除筛选条件。

catalogHint.text: 内容不可变 · 元数据可编辑

resumeHint.en: Have an upload ID? Select the same file and enter the ID below.
resumeHint.text: 已有上传 ID？请选择同一个文件，并在下方输入该 ID。

uploadHint.en: Keep your upload ID to resume after closing this tab.
uploadHint.text: 请记下上传 ID，以便关闭此标签页后继续上传。

paused.en: Transfer paused. You can resume it with the same file.
paused.text: 传输已暂停。您可以使用同一个文件继续。

selectHint.en: Open a file in the catalog or history.
selectHint.text: 在目录或历史记录中打开一个文件。

downloadLinkCopied.en: Link copied. It opens only this file and works until {expires}.
downloadLinkCopied.text: 链接已复制。它只能打开此文件，有效期至 {expires}。

downloadLinkCopy.en: Copy the link below. It opens only this file and works until {expires}.
downloadLinkCopy.text: 请复制下方的链接。它只能打开此文件，有效期至 {expires}。

assetHint.en: Assign this artifact to a path. The current link version protects against simultaneous changes: use 0 for a new path or the current version shown in the file history.
assetHint.text: 将此制品分配到一个路径。当前链接版本用于防止同时修改：新路径请填写 0，否则请填写文件历史记录中显示的当前版本。

historyHint.en: Restoring creates a new version. Open any version to download its original file.
historyHint.text: 恢复会创建一个新版本。打开任意版本即可下载其原始文件。

historyEmpty.en: Enter a file path to explore its history.
historyEmpty.text: 输入文件路径以查看其历史记录。

historyCount.text: 已加载 {count} 个版本 · 当前版本 {revision}

historyConflict.en: The file has changed. Reload history before restoring.
historyConflict.text: 文件已更改。恢复前请重新加载历史记录。

assigned.text: 文件链接已保存 · 版本 {revision}

fileTooLarge.en: The file exceeds the maximum size configured on the server.
fileTooLarge.text: 文件超过服务器设置的最大大小。

uploadRunning.en: An upload is already in progress.

hashError.en: Could not read or verify the selected file. Please select it again.
hashError.text: 无法读取或验证所选文件。请重新选择该文件。

saveUnsupported.en: Streaming save requires Chrome or Edge over HTTPS. Other clients can download through the SDK.
saveUnsupported.text: 流式保存需要通过 HTTPS 使用 Chrome 或 Edge。其他客户端可以通过 SDK 下载。

mismatch.en: This file differs from the upload. Select the original file or start a new upload.
mismatch.text: 此文件与上传中的文件不一致。请选择原始文件，或开始新的上传。

errorGeneric.en: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
errorGeneric.text: 无法完成该操作。请重试。

errorUnauthorized.en: This key is not valid or was revoked. Enter a valid key.
errorUnauthorized.text: 此密钥无效或已被撤销。请输入有效的密钥。

errorForbidden.en: You do not have permission for this operation.
errorForbidden.text: 您没有执行此操作的权限。

errorRateLimited.en: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait and try again.
errorRateLimited.text: 登录尝试次数过多。请稍后重试。

errorNotFound.en: The requested file or version was not found.
errorNotFound.text: 未找到请求的文件或版本。

errorConflict.en: The item has changed or the operation conflicts with its state. Refresh before trying again.
errorConflict.text: 该项目已更改，或操作与其当前状态冲突。请刷新后重试。

errorInput.en: Check the entered values and try again.
errorInput.text: 请检查输入的值后重试。

errorIntegrity.en: The file integrity check failed. Retry with the original file.
errorIntegrity.text: 文件完整性检查失败。请使用原始文件重试。

errorBusy.en: The service is busy. Try again shortly.

errorCapacity.en: A capacity limit has been reached.

publishedRefresh.en: File published, but the catalog could not refresh. Open Artifacts to refresh it.
publishedRefresh.text: 文件已发布，但目录未能刷新。请打开“制品”进行刷新。

noScript.en: Enable JavaScript to use the storage console.
noScript.text: 请启用 JavaScript 以使用存储控制台。
